name: Axii
primary: The Witcher's sign of the mind. A wave of calm washes over a 50° cone, 8 blocks long. Hostile mobs in it (not bosses) are stunned for 0.5 s and bewitched for 8 s: they won't attack players and turn on other hostile mobs instead.
self_description: You calm your own mind: stun removed, heal 1 ❤.
